title: Air Data Computer Altitude & Airspeed Low-Speed Bus
description: Low-speed (12.5 kbps) ARINC 429 Air Data Computer bus carrying pressure altitude (Label 203) and computed airspeed (Label 206) with valid odd-parity BNR words.
code:
# Air Data Computer (ADC) Low-Speed ARINC 429 Bus (12.5 kbps)
BUS ADC_PRIMARY_BUS
RATE LOW
LABEL 203 ALTITUDE ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 131072 RESOLUTION 0.5 UNITS ft RATE 16 EQUIPMENT ADC
LABEL 206 COMPUTED_AIRSPEED ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 1024 RESOLUTION 0.00390625 UNITS kt RATE 16 EQUIPMENT ADC
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0x614820C1 # 10500 ft
FRAME 0.025 WORD 0x635C0061 # 215.0 kt
FRAME 0.062 WORD 0x614960C1 # 10540 ft
FRAME 0.087 WORD 0xE3620061 # 216.5 kt

title: Inertial Reference System Pitch, Roll & True Heading Bus
description: High-speed (100 kbps) ARINC 429 Inertial Reference System bus transmitting 50 Hz pitch angle (324), roll angle (325), and true heading (314) during a shallow left bank.
code:
# Inertial Reference System (IRS) High-Speed Attitude & Heading Bus (100 kbps)
BUS IRS_ATTITUDE_BUS_1
RATE HIGH
LABEL 324 PITCH_ANGLE ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 180 RESOLUTION 0.0054931640625 UNITS deg RATE 50 EQUIPMENT IRS
LABEL 325 ROLL_ANGLE ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 180 RESOLUTION 0.0054931640625 UNITS deg RATE 50 EQUIPMENT IRS
LABEL 314 TRUE_HEADING ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 180 RESOLUTION 0.0054931640625 UNITS deg RATE 20 EQUIPMENT IRS
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0x6009F42B # Pitch +3.5 deg
FRAME 0.005 WORD 0xFFDD28AB # Roll -12.25 deg
FRAME 0.010 WORD 0xE0F05C33 # Heading 084.5 deg
FRAME 0.020 WORD 0x600AD02B # Pitch +3.8 deg
FRAME 0.025 WORD 0x7FE390AB # Roll -10.0 deg
FRAME 0.030 WORD 0xE0ECA833 # Heading 083.2 deg

title: Dual-Channel VHF, VOR & ILS Radio Navigation Bus
description: Mixed BCD and BNR ARINC 429 radio navigation bus encoding tuned ILS/VOR frequency (034), VHF comm frequency (035), localizer deviation (173), and glideslope deviation (174).
code:
# VHF / VOR / ILS Approach Radio Navigation Bus (Mixed BCD + BNR)
BUS NAV_RADIO_BUS_1
RATE LOW
LABEL 034 VOR_ILS_FREQ ENCODING BCD SDI 1 RESOLUTION 0.01 UNITS MHz RATE 5 EQUIPMENT MMR
LABEL 035 VHF_COMM_FREQ ENCODING BCD SDI 1 RESOLUTION 0.01 UNITS MHz RATE 5 EQUIPMENT VHF
LABEL 173 LOCALIZER_DEV ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 0.4 RESOLUTION 0.0001 UNITS DDM RATE 20 EQUIPMENT MMR
LABEL 174 GLIDESLOPE_DEV ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 0.8 RESOLUTION 0.0001 UNITS DDM RATE 20 EQUIPMENT MMR
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0x8440C138 # ILS 110.30 MHz
FRAME 0.020 WORD 0x846195B8 # Tower 118.65 MHz
FRAME 0.040 WORD 0x600259DE # Localizer +0.015 DDM
FRAME 0.060 WORD 0x7FFC913E # Glideslope -0.022 DDM

title: FADEC Turbofan Engine N1, N2, EGT & Fuel-Flow Bus
description: High-speed ARINC 429 FADEC propulsion telemetry bus streaming fan speed N1 (346), core speed N2 (344), exhaust gas temperature EGT (345), and fuel mass flow (244) at cruise thrust.
code:
# FADEC Channel A Turbofan Engine #1 Telemetry Bus (Cruise Climb)
BUS FADEC_ENG1_CH_A
RATE HIGH
LABEL 346 FAN_SPEED_N1 ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 128 RESOLUTION 0.015625 UNITS pct RATE 20 EQUIPMENT FADEC
LABEL 344 CORE_SPEED_N2 ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 128 RESOLUTION 0.015625 UNITS pct RATE 20 EQUIPMENT FADEC
LABEL 345 EXHAUST_GAS_TEMP ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 2048 RESOLUTION 0.25 UNITS degC RATE 10 EQUIPMENT FADEC
LABEL 244 FUEL_FLOW ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 32768 RESOLUTION 0.5 UNITS pph RATE 10 EQUIPMENT FADEC
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0xE0586967 # N1 88.4 pct
FRAME 0.010 WORD 0x605E3527 # N2 94.2 pct
FRAME 0.020 WORD 0xE02E61A7 # EGT 742.0 degC
FRAME 0.030 WORD 0xE0627125 # Fuel Flow 3150 pph
FRAME 0.050 WORD 0xE0589967 # N1 88.6 pct
FRAME 0.060 WORD 0xE02E89A7 # EGT 744.5 degC

title: Flight-Control Glass-Cockpit Multi-Label PFD Bus Capture
description: Integrated 100 kbps Primary Flight Display (PFD) ARINC 429 bus combining baro altitude, Mach number, vertical speed, pitch/roll attitude, ground speed, and autopilot discrete status.
code:
# Integrated Primary Flight Display (PFD) High-Speed ARINC 429 Bus Capture (FL350 Cruise)
BUS PFD_EFIS_BUS_A
RATE HIGH
LABEL 203 BARO_ALTITUDE ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 131072 RESOLUTION 0.5 UNITS ft RATE 20 EQUIPMENT ADC
LABEL 205 MACH_NUMBER ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 4.096 RESOLUTION 0.0000625 UNITS Mach RATE 20 EQUIPMENT ADC
LABEL 212 ALTITUDE_RATE ENCODING BNR SDI 0 RANGE 32768 RESOLUTION 0.25 UNITS fpm RATE 20 EQUIPMENT ADC
LABEL 324 PITCH_ANGLE ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 180 RESOLUTION 0.0054931640625 UNITS deg RATE 50 EQUIPMENT IRS
LABEL 325 ROLL_ANGLE ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 180 RESOLUTION 0.0054931640625 UNITS deg RATE 50 EQUIPMENT IRS
LABEL 312 GROUND_SPEED ENCODING BNR SDI 1 RANGE 4096 RESOLUTION 0.015625 UNITS kt RATE 20 EQUIPMENT IRS
LABEL 270 AFCS_STATUS ENCODING DISCRETE SDI 0 UNITS bits RATE 10 EQUIPMENT FCC
FRAME 0.000 WORD 0x6445C0C1 # FL350
FRAME 0.004 WORD 0x60C440A1 # M 0.785
FRAME 0.008 WORD 0x60078051 # +120 fpm
FRAME 0.012 WORD 0xE005F92B # Pitch +2.1 deg
FRAME 0.016 WORD 0x600125AB # Roll +0.4 deg
FRAME 0.020 WORD 0xE1D40153 # GS 468.0 kt
FRAME 0.024 WORD 0x0000541D # AP CMD A + LNAV + VNAV engaged
FRAME 0.050 WORD 0x6445E8C1 # 35005 ft
FRAME 0.054 WORD 0x61D48153 # GS 468.5 kt
